content: पराचीन {%a.%} [पराच्-ख] .²1 Turned in an opposite direction, averted; पराचीनोऽभवत्तेभ्यः <ls>Śiva B. 27. 42</ls>. .²2 Averse from, disinclined to. .²3 Not minding, not caring about. .²4 Happening subsequently or afterwards (उत्तरकालभव). .²5 Situated on the other side, being beyond; न कदाचित् पराचीना भवितुमुत्सहन्ते <ls>Bhāg. 5. 20. 37</ls>. .²6 Unfit, improper. .²7 Outward (वहिर्मुख); ज्ञानमेकं पराचीनैरिन्द्रियैर्ब्रह्म निर्गुणम् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 32. 28</ls>. .{@-नम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Away from, beyond. .²2 More than.
